s: Today's show is all about technology in daily life.
We will talk about small problems and easy answers.
Let's start with a busy morning.
Yesterday, I woke up late, and my phone battery was almost empty.
A charger is so important in the morning.
My charger lives next to my bed.
I always plug in my phone before I sleep.
My charger was in the kitchen.
I ran to the kitchen, and I plugged in my phone.
Without my charger, my phone dies fast.
A phone without power is just a toy.
I think everyone needs two chargers: one for home, and one for the bag.
I bought a second charger last week.
Now my old charger stays at home, and the new charger travels with me.
And after you wake up, do you check your email first?
I open my laptop, and I read my email.
Yesterday I had eleven new emails.
I read my email on my phone.
My email app is very easy to use.
My boss sends an email every morning.
Then I write a short email back.
My emails are always short and polite.
By the way, when I started my new job, they gave me a new laptop.
It is light, and it fits in my bag.
A good laptop is a great friend.
I use my laptop every day.
In the morning I open my laptop for email, and at night I watch a movie on my laptop.
The screen is bright, and the keyboard is quiet.
Before we go on, a quick note about the Muse English app.
Every day it gives you new words with photos and clear pronunciation.
You can hear this podcast, practice shadowing stories, take fun quizzes, learn grammar, and win points on the leaderboard.
It is free, and it helps you learn a little every day.
At the office, I type all day.
A comfortable keyboard makes life better.
My keyboard at home is small, but my office keyboard is big.
The keys are soft, and my fingers move fast.
Do you know the keyboard shortcuts?
On my laptop I press a key, and the screen changes.
A good keyboard saves so much time.
At first my keyboard felt strange, but now I love it.
Every good worker needs a good keyboard and a good chair.
At the airport last month, there was no free wifi.
I asked, "Where is the wifi password?"
Airports and bad wifi, what a pair.
At home my wifi is fast.
I use the wifi for video calls, for email, and for my laptop.
I go there with my laptop, I order coffee, and I use the free wifi to work.
Free wifi is the best gift.
When the wifi is slow, I feel nervous.
I restart the box, and the wifi comes back.
Wifi is like air: you only see it when it is gone.
One more thing about the Muse English app.
You hear new words on this show, then the app shows them with photos and slow pronunciation.
You can read the transcript, do shadowing stories, test yourself with quizzes, study short grammar lessons, and climb the leaderboard for points.
Install it today and learn English with us!
Let's finish with a little story.
Last night, I forgot my charger again.
My phone was dead, so I could not send an email to my teacher.
I opened my laptop and sent the email from my laptop.
Then I found my charger under the sofa!
So today we learned five useful words: charger, keyboard, wifi, email, and laptop.
And remember: technology is here to help us.
Thanks for listening to Muse English!
